thesis: Train on *actual published physical-wind-tunnel intervention measurements*, not any authored synthetic world, and compare tokenless direct-effect weights to independent strong statistical controls with matched public measurement history. No original-world interactions, no blind scientific acceptance.

external_source.data_license: CC BY 4.0; attribution to Gamella, Peters, Bühlmann, Nature Machine Intelligence 2025

frozen_data_selection.runs: load_in_seed_0 through load_in_seed_9 (actual 2024 real physical measurements)
frozen_data_selection.event_boundary: intervention column equals 1 at first sample after SET; do NOT use future target readings as model inputs
frozen_data_selection.event_target: within each event, post-settling mean over ordinal measurement offsets 15..79, inclusive, for rpm_in and pressure_intake (65 rows); reject too-short events, incomplete/nonfinite columns, mixing runs or timestamps. No relabeling of source as direct matched-exogenous do pairs.
frozen_data_selection.input: load_in value at first event row, optional previously completed event's measured outputs and load in same run; NEVER current event future sensor targets before prediction
frozen_data_selection.evaluation: weighted mean over events of two output root-mean-squared-error values each scaled by FIT-only sample standard deviation. Also raw per-output RMSE and per-run event counts.
frozen_data_selection.physical_caveat: Source manipulations keep other actuators fixed within each run; no guaranteed paired exogenous counterfactuals; real measurement noise, time drift, and serial dependence.

frozen_controls.pass1: direct scalar weight-programming via online recursive least squares (intercept+load), independent fully-fitted batch ridge with identical features (must tie up to numerical precision), FIT-only mean, fitted four-level categorical means
frozen_controls.pass2: optional bounded post-event contradiction correction using only prior same-run observed event residuals; compare same-info conventional ARX model with previous event load and target, plus persistence
frozen_controls.training: All models fit on same six FIT runs, select between pass1 and pass2 on VALID runs only, with at most two development passes, no public_dev tuning
frozen_controls.hyperparameters: ridge regularization 1e-6 on two-feature affine; category level fixed from four author-defined load values 0.01,0.1,0.2,0.5; difference repair gain 0.5 fixed, no tuning; conditional alpha smoothing 1 fixed
frozen_controls.unfamiliar_world_caveat: run-level public_dev holdout is not an independently new physical mechanism; no generalized scientific transfer claim
frozen_controls.score_floor: at least 5% relative improvement on public_dev normalized RMSE over strongest FIT-trained conventional control across BOTH outputs with no more than 1% old-relationship retention cost; if tied/negative, STOP and preserve results

platforms: local source-bounded artifact only until exact code qualification
budgets.stop: If data archive unavailable/hash mismatch, run IDs absent, too few interventions, or public evidence extraction invalid: stop without adapting splits.
